description: Configure and deploy AI automations for the client

params_template.prompt: Create a detailed automation setup guide for a {industry} business called {business_name}. They selected these automations: {automations_selected}. For each automation, provide: 1) What it does, 2) How to set it up using free tools (Google Sheets, Apps Script, Calendly free, Tawk.to), 3) The webhook URL format, 4) Testing instructions. Format as a clear step-by-step guide.

steps.description: Save automation guide to output directory

params_template.subject: Your AI Automations Are Configured! 🤖
params_template.body: Q-Bot has your automations set up and ready to run 24/7. Check your Client Portal for the setup guide and webhook URLs.
